verdict.stance: Overweight / Net-Cash Global Gold Producer Generating Windfall FCF (Baa3 / BB+)
verdict.summary: Record gold prices ($4,239/oz realized in Q326) drove $787m Q3 net income after FY25 adj EBITDA hit $6.29bn (+129% YoY) and flipped the balance sheet to $879m net cash (-0.14x). Strong rising-star trajectory at S&P/Fitch (BB+ vs Moody's Baa3) with no bond maturities until Nov-2028.

positives: Net cash balance sheet ($879m net cash at YE25) and $6.29bn FY25 adj EBITDA.
Geographically diversified Tier-1/Tier-2 assets (Tanzania, Ghana, Australia, Americas, Sukari Egypt) after NYSE/UK redomiciliation.
Low fixed-coupon USD bond stack (3.375%-3.75% for 2028/2030).
negatives: Gold price cyclicality and elevated royalty/tax regimes in West Africa and Tanzania.
Weather/operational interruptions in Q326 production volumes.
Exposure to South Africa macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.
